question: What ritual purification is described as constantly rising upward from Brahman?
premises: It is to be done always
It is described as gone upward from Brahman
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is described as rising upward from Brahman.
uncertainties: Symbolic meaning of ūrddha gatam and brahmaṇaḥ is uncertain
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward from Brahman.
